entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Two aspects of one plane with Shadowmoor; the day state, home to kithkin and boggarts.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The night aspect of Lorwyn, Lorwyn with almost all its memories wiped clean.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that changed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, affecting only creatures that were on the plane.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: A Lorwyn place that became Kinscaer in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A Lorwyn figure who became a cruel pirate in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: Lorwyn folk who became xenophobic wall-builders in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes among which planeswalkers choose destinations.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The shattered plane previewed in Shards of Alara.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: One of the Shards of Alara, home to undead savagery.

entities.name: Planeswalker Spark
entities.description: The spark of planeswalking, whose nature the Time Spiral block events changed so planeswalkers became mortal.

events.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, affecting only creatures present on the plane.
events.quote: the Great Aurora only affects creatures that were there on the plane during the event

events.summary: Kithkin become xenophobic wall-builders in Shadowmoor.
events.quote: the kithkin she was accustomed to had become xenophobic little wall-builders

events.summary: Sygg takes up cruel piracy in Shadowmoor.
events.quote: could recognize Sygg despite his new penchant for cruel piracy

events.summary: Time Spiral block events change the planeswalker spark so planeswalkers become mortal.
events.quote: The events of the Time Spiral block changed the nature of the planeswalker spark

relations.note: They are two aspects of the same plane.
relations.quote: Lorwyn and Shadowmoor are two aspects of the same plane

relations.note: Grixis is one of the Shards of Alara.
relations.quote: you are going to love Grixis, one of the Shards of Alara
